text_block_list.text:
With the Mainichi Okan now behind us,
we steer
ahead for the autumn Tenno
Sho. The days
leading to it are full of
nothing but training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Her times are improving daily!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Amazing! You're getting so fast!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Which is great, but...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: But what?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, nothing! Just... don't overwork
yourself,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks for your concern, but I'm
having so
much fun right now. You don't
have to worry
about me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
We continue training until the day right
before
the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Nothing beats a nice hot bath!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Suzuka, what's with the compress
on your
leg?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it hurts a little so I thought it'd be
best to put
it on, just in case.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: What?! But tomorrow's—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It's okay. I can still run.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Wait, just think about it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
So you want me to withdraw from the
autumn
Tenno Sho tomorrow?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, I know you're unbelievably
strong...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You can run on and on without slowing
down for
even a second, and my heart
feels so full every
time I see you do just
that...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why I'm so worried
about you! If
something were to happen,
then...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Please! I don't know what I'd do if you
couldn't
run!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: A heavy silence falls over the room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Listen, Spe...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I never could have made it where I am
now on my
own.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The only reason I've managed to get so
far is
because... you and Trainer believed
in me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: As I am right now—as we are right now—I just know the scenery will be truly incredible tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
We're Umamusume... We're all going to
reach our
peak at some point or other.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What if right now, I'm the fastest I'll ever
be?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's race could be the only
chance I'll
have to compete at my very
best.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: So please understand, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can't maintain their peak
condition
forever. Once they've passed
their prime as an
athlete, their abilities
will only decline.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You're not being fair!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just mean that, no matter
what I say,
I can't stop you?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Spe...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But I'll be okay. You have to believe me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
"Promise me you'll come back safe." The
words
with which Спешл Уик sends
Сайленс Судзука off
are short but
heartfelt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
